Product key: globalstat
Aliases: GlobalStat Country / Domain Intelligence Slice
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/globalstat/index.html
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/evercraft-machine-commerce

AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/globalstat/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- compare these countries on this metric
- give me sourced country intelligence
- which countries lead on this domain and why
- show me the evidence behind this country score
- reconcile conflicting country data
- country benchmark with sources

## Authority

public discovery of sourced country-level comparative intelligence with evidence state, freshness and reconciliation warnings

## Boundaries

- opaque rankings are not treated as evidence
- a country-brief price range has been discussed but no approved fixed machine price or payment path is verified
- read-only sourced data may be returned within approved access
- paid work requires explicit confirmation and verified terms

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
